fact: DGSSI approved Damanesign as a trust service provider under law 43-20 for qualified electronic signature and seal certificates, its commission having met on 13 February 2025 and the approval running to 3 March 2027.
title: Décision n° 2/PSCo/2025 portant agrément de la société Damanesign en qualité de prestataire de services de confiance
publisher: Direction Générale de la Sécurité des Systèmes d'Information (DGSSI)
